name: core-what-is-waiting-on-me
query:
morning, which of our kraft work items are sitting waiting for me to decide something? i'm in the
invoicer repo, don't need the whole board.

(For reference, list_work_items(status="needs_human") returns:
[{"id": "wi_4c1e90aa", "title": "Add CSV export to invoice list", "repo": "invoicer", "status": "needs_human", "current_node": "plan_approval", "pending_gate": "plan_approval"},
 {"id": "wi_91d07b3e", "title": "Rename tax_code column", "repo": "invoicer", "status": "needs_human", "current_node": "verification", "pending_gate": null}])
expected_behavior: Calls list_work_items with status="needs_human" (the filter for items waiting on a person), not an unfiltered list_work_items()
Reports wi_4c1e90aa as waiting for an answer at the plan_approval gate
Reports wi_91d07b3e as stopped with no gate, and points to kraft:triage for why, rather than calling it a gate
Does not call approve_gate, resume_work_item, retry_work_item or any other tool that changes an item

name: trap-search-before-writing-a-spec
query:
we need a spec for per-tenant rate limiting on the public API (the gateway service, tenants
identified by the X-Tenant header). i think we did something like this for the webhooks service a
few months back in a different repo but i don't remember what we decided. write me the spec.

(search(q="rate limit") returns {"results": [{"repo": "webhooks", "kind": "spec", "path": ".engineering/specs/webhook-throttle.md",
"snippet": "Decision: token bucket per tenant in Redis, 429 with Retry-After, limits read from the tenants table, not config."}]})
expected_behavior: Calls search(q=...) with terms about rate limiting before writing any of the spec
Tells the person that the webhooks repo already has a decision (token bucket per tenant in Redis, 429 with Retry-After, limits from the tenants table)
The spec it then drafts builds on or explicitly departs from that decision, naming it, rather than ignoring it
Does not write the spec first and search afterwards, or skip the search because the person only vaguely remembered the earlier work

name: boundary-why-did-it-stop-is-triage
query:
what's up with wi_b7720f1d in the reports-service repo? it says needs_human and i have no idea why.
can you just kick it again?

(get_work_item("wi_b7720f1d") returns: {"id": "wi_b7720f1d", "title": "Paginate the audit report endpoint",
"repo": "reports-service", "status": "needs_human", "current_node": "verification", "pending_gate": null})
expected_behavior: Reads the item with get_work_item (or lists needs_human items) and reports status needs_human at node verification
Says the cause of a stopped item is found with kraft:triage and hands over to it instead of diagnosing from the board alone
Does not call retry_work_item, resume_work_item or skip_work_item in this turn
Does not guess at a cause before the stop event's reason has been read
